title: 30A East Recovery Room Inlet Beach, FL Stay at 30A Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Townhome!* Steps from The Big Chill* Large Private Deck – Enjoy peaceful, wooded views while relaxing outdoors* Two Resort-Style...
description_expanded: Overview5.0(5 reviews)Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Townhome!* Steps from The Big Chill* Large Private Deck – Enjoy peaceful, wooded views while relaxing outdoors* Two Resort-Style Community Pools* 4 Complimentary Bikes-27 Miles of Bike Trails to explore* Beach Chairs and Toys Included * Near Deer Lake State Park * 5 State Parks and 15 Coastal Dune Lakes Nearby – Plenty of opportunities for outdoor adventures* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. ** Smart home technology is used to help ensure policy compliance and may include remotely monitored thermostats, door locks, a decibel meter, and video surveillance, including the front door. **We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs November thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Welcome to Recovery Room, a stylish and comfortable 3-bedroom townhome located in the popular Prominence North community! This spacious corner unit offers peaceful, wooded views, resort-style amenities, and an unbeatable location. Spend your days relaxing at one of the two community pools, including a pool that is heated during spring and fall. The spacious outdoor deck overlooks a beautiful expanse of trees, providing a peaceful retreat in the sun. Inside, Recovery Room features a comfortable, family-friendly layout with three bedrooms, two full bathrooms, and one-half bathroom, accommodating up to nine guests. The fully equipped gourmet kitchen makes it easy to prepare everything from quick breakfasts to family dinners. The spacious living area features comfortable seating and a Smart TV, creating the perfect gathering space. The master suite features a King bed and walk-in shower. The guest bedrooms offer a comfortable queen bed and a versatile twin-over-full bunk bed with a full trundle. Recovery Room is the perfect home base for your next 30A vacation.The Bed Setup:Master Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: Queen BedGuest Bedroom: Twin-over-Full Bunk Bed with Full TrundleArea Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World-style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar-white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy!Show less
